events.title: 2027 Freedom Sprints — Free SCCA Road Racing and Public Paddock Access
events.time: MDT; event-specific timetable not yet published; typical SCCA practice from 8 AM, racing around 1–5 PM
events.location: High Plains Raceway, 93301 East US Highway 36, Deer Trail, CO 80105
events.cost: Free spectator admission, no tickets; $0 for five; food/transport separate
events.age: Children and adults welcome as spectators; no membership or ticket required under published spectator policy; no driving included
events.description: Annual Independence Day weekend SCCA Majors, Regionals and Time Trials. Unlike ordinary grandstand-only sports, the host explicitly permits spectators to visit the pits, see racing cars close up and talk to drivers and crews. Official policy: https://www.coloradoscca.org/calendar/spectator-info/ . Specific race timetable still pending; ear protection advised. Approx. 65 miles from Westminster city via Byers (46.8 miles to Byers plus roughly 18 miles along US36; ZIP-specific route unverified). Venue directions: https://www.highplainsraceway.com/track-info/ .
